tasks.description: Reports tickets that missed their first-response or resolution SLA target using the exported ticket queues and the SLA policy. Use when asked for an SLA breach report on exported support tickets.
tasks.intent: Report tickets that breached their SLA targets.

tasks.description: Summarises the open and pending ticket backlog per team with priority counts, oldest ticket and customer tier. Use when asked for a backlog summary by team from exported tickets.
tasks.intent: Summarise the unresolved ticket backlog by team.

tasks.description: Finds pairs of exported tickets with near-identical titles and suggests which to merge. Use when asked for a likely-duplicate report on exported tickets.
tasks.intent: Find likely duplicate tickets by title similarity.
